description: Use to discover how to answer a model-analysis question across ChatGPT, the interactive deepbom.org workspace and the local CLI. Returns real query sections, visualization/export actions, explicit web continuation links, required inputs, CLI argument templates and evidence limits for weights, pruning investigation, comparison, BOM verification, metadata/OMOP, activation evidence, runtime, batch/CI and integrations. No attachment is required. This is guidance, not a completed analysis or local command execution. Prefer answering from existing evidence; inspect supported follow-ups with deepbom_query_file before offering web continuation for richer interaction. Website links transfer only a workflow ID, never model data.

format.description: Optional known artifact format; filters applicable workflows, not per-file analysis coverage.
